title: Courses · Objectives / Outcomes / Requirements
intro: Mobbin evidence for structured objectives and learner-visible outcomes.

questions.title: Objectives are structured (list items, not free text) and reorderable
Objectives are visible to the learner in the same shape the instructor authored them

references.title: Course setup bullet points editor
references.question: Q1
references.take: Teachable exposes multiple individually editable bullet point fields with an explicit Add a Bullet Point control in course setup.

references.title: Additional course setup bullet points
references.question: Q1
references.take: The editor continues the same repeated bullet structure with populated and placeholder fields, showing objectives are stored as separate items rather than one paragraph.

references.title: Course page What you'll learn
references.question: Q2
references.take: Coursera presents a learner-facing What you'll learn section as a checked list of discrete outcome statements, preserving authored item shape for course discovery.

references.title: Curriculum preview
references.question: Q2
references.take: Teachable’s three-step curriculum preview shows the learner-facing course structure across a sequence; it evidences the read surface but does not prove identical author-to-learner objective text.

references.title: Course landing page outcomes
references.question: Q2
references.take: Udemy’s course landing page exposes a dedicated learner-facing learning outcomes area, making expected achievement scannable before enrollment.

references.title: Course outcomes list
references.question: Q2
references.take: A second Udemy course view shows outcomes as discrete learner-readable items, supporting a checklist-style presentation of objectives.

references.title: Intended learners objectives step
references.question: Q1
references.take: Udemy requires at least four learning objectives/outcomes as separate fields, shows per-item character counts, and offers Add more to your response.

references.title: Curriculum section learning objective
references.question: Q1
references.take: Udemy’s curriculum editor places a learning objective field inside each section and pairs it with Add Section and Add Curriculum item controls.

references.title: Mobile course outcomes view
references.question: Q2
references.take: Coursera’s iOS course detail view shows a Syllabus: What you will learn section with module headings and explanatory copy as a mobile learner surface.

references.title: About this course
references.question: Q2
references.take: Udemy’s iOS About this course flow provides a short learner journey into course information; it supports mobile exposure of course expectations without proving authoring fidelity.
